I have completed wiring `durabilityTracker` into `Open()`, `DB.Close()`, and `DB.Metrics()`, and started running the existing unit test suite to verify compilation and baseline behavior.
I have created [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability_test.go) and launched the race-enabled test run in the container.
I have implemented the `BatchDurable` callback, durability wait/notification APIs, statistics, and metrics on the `batch-durability` branch:

- **EventListener & Options** ([event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go), [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/options.go)):
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go#L803-L824) and [`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go#L971-L975), wired through [`EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go#L985-L987), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go#L1122), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/event.go#L1301-L1306).
  - Added [`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/options.go#L43-L45) and helper [`getCommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/options.go#L53-L58).
- **Commit Pipeline & Batch Integration** ([commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/commit.go), [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/batch.go), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/db.go), [open.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/open.go)):
  - Separated sequence publish synchronization (`b.commit`) from WAL fsync completion (`b.fsyncWait`) in [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/commit.go#L299-L377) and [`commitPipeline.prepare`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/commit.go#L452-L501) to measure `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration` independently and fire `BatchDurable` once per `Sync` commit after WAL sync completes (including on failure), while skipping non-sync commits and `DisableWAL`.
- **Durability APIs, Stats, and Metrics** ([durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go), [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/metrics.go), [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability_test.go)):
  - Implemented [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L375-L377), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L382-L442), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L446-L448), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L453-L490), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L495-L497), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L502-L588), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L592-L596), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L601-L634), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/durability.go#L637-L649).
  - Exposed [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/metrics.go#L283-L285) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-88reefe7/metrics.go#L286-L289), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
